place.pin: Place-pin: draw pin_shadow (anchors.pin_shadow) on the spot, then pin_<color> with anchors.pin on the spot, then icon_<castId> at (pinIcon.left, pinIcon.top) inside the pin frame, on the INNER disc only (radius 5: leave the 1-px socket ring of the frame visible). Depth-sort place pins with characters/props by the spot (pixel3d: depth-tested pass, src/ui/markers/pinPass.js). Person-pin: same without the shadow, tip 1 px above the target's name label box, 1 px bob at 2 fps, fanned (never rotated). Play pin_drop_0..3 once at the spot when a pin lands (fps.pin_drop, held 2 grid frames each), under the pin body.
place.point: Pick the dir whose vector is closest to (target - emoter). Draw point_<dir>_<f> with anchors.point at emoterHead + vector * point.offset (pixel3d emoterHead = feet + 0.72 x height; v2 feet - 26 px), looping point.sequence at fps.point for EMOTE_POINT_MS. Loop ping_0..3 at the pointed spot (anchors.ping) at fps.ping, under characters; for a person target at their feet. Trail dots (trail_0/1) every 6 px from the fingertip to the aim point, drawn BELOW name labels and chat bubbles; the finger above them.
place.icon: icon_<castId> is a round 12x12 portrait (transparent outside the disc), baked by the portraits group (out/ui/portraits.json). Also usable as a UI avatar; emote_point (emotes group) is the palette button icon.

tiers.pin: place: W-billboard (depth-tested pin pass, order 301: over L.ground decals, under every L.world texel) / person: A (L.world)
tiers.pin_shadow: with the place pin (depth-tested, under its body)
tiers.pin_drop: with the place pin (under its body); person pins: A

markers.pinMidNote: baked body mid per colour; equal to pinColorHex except white (#DCD3C4: v2 #ece6da was brighter than the cream rim/text tokens, so the ramp keeps the cream highlight on top)
markers.pinIconInner: icons go on the 12x12 disc minus its 1-px edge (radius 5); the edge is the socket ring (upper-left parchmentSh, lower-right parchmentHi; white pin: its own line/shade) that separates any icon from any pin colour

extras.pin_remove: 9x9 remove badge (v2 art.ts BADGE), anchor = centre; shown on hover/tap of your own pin, centre at pin frame (15,2)
extras.trail_0: trail dot (bright), every 6 px from the fingertip to the aim point, marching 1 px per 7.5 fps step
extras.trail_1: trail dot (dim), the first dot next to the hand
extras.ping_mark: chevron over a pointed PLACE, tip 4 px above the spot, 1 px bob at 2 fps
extras.pick_0: Storyteller pick crosshair (v2 gameplay stagePick), frames 0..2, sequence [0,1,2,1] at 7.5 fps; label right-below

markers.emoterHead: feet + 0.72 x character height (v2: feet - 26 px)
markers.personAim: target feet + 0.4 x height (v2: feet - 14 px)
markers.personPin: tip 1 px above the name label box (label top = head anchor - 11); fan dx = k * 18 * min(.62, 2.4/n), dy = |k| * 1.5, never rotated

v2size.note: pointerScale v2: the finger at the size the v2 finger had relative to the v2 cast, scaled to the pixel3d cast at the game camera (K = pixel3d cast median height / v2 cast median height). Redrawn at that size (no upscaled pixels). Draw at emoterHead + vector * point.offset with anchors.point; the trail starts point.size / 2 from the anchor.
